paper.title: From Procedural Skills to Strategy Genes: Towards Experience-Driven Test-Time Evolution
paper.central_claim: Compact structured strategy genes outperform documentation-oriented skills as test-time control and as an evolution-ready persistent interface; controlled probes and two CritPt gene-evolved systems support iterative improvement beyond base models.

evidence.quote: We study this question in 4,590 controlled trials across 45 scientific code-solving scenarios.

Beyond one-shot control, we show that Gene is also a better carrier for iterative experience accumulation: attached failure history is more effective in Gene than in Skill or freeform text, editable structure matters beyond content alone, and failure information is most useful when distilled into compact warnings rather than naively appended.
